newsitem.title: UK: Norway buys 9,000 tonnes of wheat for Feb shipment.
newsitem.headline: Norway buys 9,000 tonnes of wheat for Feb shipment.

text.p: Norway's Stadkorn has bought 9,000 tonnes of wheat for February shipment, a company spokesman told Reuters by telephone from Oslo.
The price paid was $145.50 a tonne fob, he said.
It will come from a range of origins, including the UK, Denmark and north Germany, he said.
The protein content set is 11 per cent.
Stadkorn is a state company, but is not the only importer of grain into Norway, the spokesman said.
"Anyone can import grain into Norway, provided they pay the import levy," he said.
